values.note: Village rates: grass sites (water/electric) $35 a night, gravel $42, the concrete site $47, full hookup $50; $5 less for seniors 60+, Plain City residents and active-duty or retired military (promo code at checkout). Primitive tent sites $25. Campspot quoted the same $35-50 for October 2026, plus a $3 booking fee once per stay.

fees.source: https://www.plaincityohio.gov/government/parks___recreation/campground.php ('Grass sites are $35/night, or $30/night for seniors (60+), Plain City residents, or military', 'Gravel sites are $42/night', 'Concrete site is $47/night', 'Full Hook Up campsites are $50/night', 'Tent Sites are $25/night'), read 2026-10-30; Campspot one-night quotes and 'Booking Fee', read 2026-10-13

values.note: 56 RV sites with city water and electric: 38 grass sites (1-38; snug side by side but very long, 1-5 pull-through, the rest alternating pull-in and back-in; about half have 50 amp), three back-in full-hookup sites (39-41; 60, 50 and 40 ft pads), 14 back-in gravel sites (42-55) and one concrete site (56), the last 15 on 70 x 15 ft pads. Four primitive tent sites (57-60).

sites.source: https://www.plaincityohio.gov/government/parks___recreation/campground.php ('Grass Sites #1-38', 'Campsites #1- 5 are considered pull through campsites', 'Gravel Sites #42-55 ... all 70ft L x 15ft W pads', 'Concrete Site #56 ... 70ft L x 15ft W', 'Site #39 - 60ft ... #40 - 50ft ... #41 - 40ft', 'Primitive Tent Sites #57-60'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Restroom and shower house in the middle of the campground; free dump station for registered campers, weekly mobile dump service $40. Firewood $5 a bundle at the camp office. Disc golf, half-mile walking trail, playground, three shelters.

facilities.source: https://www.plaincityohio.gov/government/parks___recreation/campground.php ('Restroom and shower house located in the middle of the campground', 'A free dump station is available for registered campers', 'Mobile dump service is offered once a week for $40', 'treated city water'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'The campground is open April 1st through October 31st.'

Book on Campspot ('MAKE A RESERVATION'); the season's reservations open January 1. A few sites are first-come, first-served and not bookable online (the page says sites 6-7 in one place and 6-10 in summer in another). 3-night minimum on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends; no arrivals or departures on July 4 and October 17 (park events). RV stays up to 30 days, then 14 days out of the park; tent stays 14 days a season.
